name: PrestaShop
description: PrestaShop is an open-source, self-hostable ecommerce platform (with an optional managed-hosting option) that lets merchants build a fully customizable store.
best_for: Positioned for merchants at all stages, from entrepreneurs launching a first store to established retailers scaling to millions in revenue.

tiers.name: Classic (open source, self-hosted)
tiers.notes: Free forever download of the PrestaShop core. Hosting, domain, and installation are not included and must be sourced separately.

tiers.name: Hosted (annual billing)
tiers.notes: Excluding VAT. About 17% cheaper than the monthly no-commitment rate. Includes 50GB hosting, managed install, and GDPR/VAT tooling.

tiers.name: Hosted (monthly, no commitment)
tiers.notes: Excluding VAT. Cancel anytime, no annual lock-in. The 14-day free trial requires payment info at signup and auto-converts to paid unless cancelled first.

cons: The free open-source core explicitly excludes hosting and domain costs -- the vendor's own pricing page states these associated costs are not included, so the real cost of running a store is entirely separate from the free software.
The advertised low Hosted price (€24/month) requires annual billing; paying month-to-month with no commitment costs €29/month, about 21% more.
The Hosted plan's 14-day free trial requires payment details at signup and automatically converts to a paid subscription if not cancelled before the trial ends.
features: Built-in checkout (PrestaShop Checkout) plus Stripe/Alma/Klarna integrations

alternatives.name: WooCommerce
alternatives.description: An open-source WordPress ecommerce plugin giving merchants full checkout and data ownership.
alternatives.best_for: Merchants already on WordPress wanting full control of their store.

alternatives.name: Ecwid
alternatives.description: A widget-embeddable ecommerce platform sellable on any existing site plus social channels.
alternatives.best_for: Merchants wanting to add a store to an existing website rather than rebuild it.
